scope: Five concepts guide art production. They are not engine screenshots, production-ready atlases or an approved replacement map layout.
progression: Full sketch -> mixed bright pockets -> fully bright. First approximately 2/3 of total stage is sketch-affected; last approximately 1/3 bright. Not a per-screen ratio.
boundary: B: crisp structure-led regions. No broad crossfade, noisy spray or raised torn paper. Spread timing/trigger undecided.
geometry: Preserve current team map, actors, collision, platform coordinates, camera, combat and movement. Decorative scenery may vary by district.
terrain: Bright and sketch share cap-stone size, contact line, wall contour, corner and modular platform geometry.
shading: Large light faces, sparse local shadows/hatching, distant simple silhouettes. Prior heavily shaded phase2 candidates remain rejected.
